text: Alex decided the style-LoRA experiment: do BOTH plans. A = 1983 comic/cel style (dataset free: 3924 stills in stills/full/), B = Frazetta oil style (gated on approved styled sheets). Eval = three-way, same chunk + seed: no-LoRA vs comic vs painting. Docs: style-lora-experiment.md; toolkit Musubi-Tuner minimax-h3 fork, Ostris v3 adapter, rank 8, ~500 steps.

Bakshi's own commentary (quoted in style-lora-experiment.md): he wanted Frazetta's painting style, not comic style, 'as that would be impossible' with rotoscope — and 'now we could just do it all with computers'. Green light for plan B as fulfilling the original vision.
